_about: Samuel Henry Butcher (1850-1910), Harvard Lectures on Greek Subjects (1904); his Aristotle's Theory of Poetry and Fine Art (Greek facing) reads 0.69 and is refused under the bar; his Odyssey with Lang is on the homer shelf: Harvard Lectures on Greek Subjects (New York: Macmillan, 1904), raw IA OCR. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. Also Some Aspects of the Greek Genius, third edition (Macmillan, 1904; first edition 1891), raw IA OCR: the third edition is taken because it carries the essay added in the second.
